description: Democratic Republic Congo (COD) - Electricity Access Rate (2012) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This dataset is the result of a Kriging interpolation of the 123 Survey in 2012 of the water access rates in COD. Coverage: the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
